targets.title: Example ridge study
targets.summary: Demonstration target with an illustrative position. A field team could record ridge morphology here in the interface; this is not an identified NASA sampling site.
targets.context: NASA interprets Mount Sharp’s boxwork ridges as associated with ancient groundwater moving through fractured rock. This describes geological history and does not establish current water or mobility safety.

targets.title: Example hollow study
targets.summary: Demonstration target with an illustrative position. Use it to practice selecting a destination and recording an observation. Local geology, slope, and traversability at this position are unverified.
targets.context: The regional image provides optical context. A hollow visible in an image is not a measured elevation difference or a confirmed terrain hazard.
